name: Marbled Hatchetfish (Carnegiella strigata)
description: True surface-dweller — keel-chested South American fish that hugs the waterline and can jump several body lengths (tank must be tightly covered). The 'hatchet' substring fires the F11.2 top-depth heuristic; the explicit `depth.preferredY` override pushes them even higher than the default TOP_PRESET.
